custom_field: Fields not yet defined by the PMO schema that you want to include with your data. Rename this column (and add more) as needed.
forward_primer_seq: The forward primer sequence for this target.
reverse_primer_seq: The reverse primer sequence for this target.
reaction_name: The reaction(s) this target was amplified in, e.g. pool1. Separate multiple reactions with commas.
forward_primers_start: Genomic start of the forward primer (0-based).
forward_primers_end: Genomic end of the forward primer (0-based).
reverse_primers_start: Genomic start of the reverse primer (0-based).
reverse_primers_end: Genomic end of the reverse primer (0-based).
insert_start: Genomic start of the insert, the region between the end of the forward primer and the beginning of the reverse primer (0-based).
strand: Which strand the location is on: + or -.
ref_seq: The reference sequence of this genomic location.
genome_id: Index (starting at 0) of the genome in the Genome Info sheet that the genomic locations refer to. Defaults to 0 if left blank.
gene_name: An identifier of the gene, if any, covered by this target.
target_attributes: Classification types for this target. Separate multiple values with commas.
name: Name of the genome.
url: A link to where this genome file can be downloaded.
gff_url: A link to where this genome's annotation file can be downloaded.
chromosomes: The chromosomes/contigs found within this genome.
library_sample_name: A unique identifier for this sequencing/amplification run of a specimen.
reads: The read count for this microhaplotype.
umis: The unique molecular identifier (UMI) count for this microhaplotype.
alt_annotations: Additional annotations associated with this microhaplotype, e.g. wildtype.
masking_seq_start: Start position(s) of masked segments within the sequence. Separate multiple values with commas.
masking_seq_segment_size: Size(s) of the masked segments. Separate multiple values with commas, in the same order as masking_seq_start.
masking_replacement_size: Size(s) of the replacement for each masked segment. Separate multiple values with commas, in the same order as masking_seq_start.
microhaplotype_name: An optional name for this microhaplotype.
pseudocigar: The pseudocigar of the microhaplotype. Requires pseudocigar_start and pseudocigar_end.
pseudocigar_chrom: Chromosome of the reference location the pseudocigar is relative to. Defaults to chrom if left blank.
pseudocigar_start: Start of the reference location the pseudocigar is relative to (0-based). Required if pseudocigar is given.
pseudocigar_end: End of the reference location the pseudocigar is relative to (0-based). Required if pseudocigar is given.
pseudocigar_ref_seq: Reference sequence of the location the pseudocigar is relative to.
pseudocigar_strand: Strand of the reference location the pseudocigar is relative to: + or -.
quality: The ASCII FASTQ per-base quality string for this sequence; must be the same length as the sequence.
additional_representative_mhap: Extra information to store with the representative microhaplotype.
additional_mhap_detected: Extra information to store with the detected microhaplotype.
specimen_name: An identifier for the specimen, unique within this sample set.
alternate_identifiers: Alternative names. Separate multiple values with commas.
specimen_taxon_id: The NCBI taxonomy number of the organism(s) in the specimen. Separate multiple values with commas for mixed samples.
host_taxon_id: The NCBI taxonomy number of the host the specimen was collected from.
collection_date: The date of specimen collection: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD.
collection_country: The country the specimen was collected in (admin level 0).
project_name: A name for the project; must be unique if multiple projects are listed.
blood_meal: Whether the host specimen has had a recent blood meal (TRUE/FALSE).
drug_usage: Drugs used by the subject and frequency of usage. Separate multiple values with commas.
env_broad_scale: The broad environment the specimen was collected from, e.g. highlands, lowlands.
env_local_scale: The local environment the specimen was collected from, e.g. jungle, urban, rural.
env_medium: The environmental medium the specimen was collected from.
geo_admin1: Geographical admin level 1, the first subdivision of a nation.
geo_admin2: Geographical admin level 2, the second subdivision of a nation.
geo_admin3: Geographical admin level 3, the third subdivision of a nation.
gravid: Whether the host is currently pregnant (TRUE/FALSE).
gravidity: Number of previous pregnancies of the host.
has_travel_out_six_month: Whether the host has travelled out of the local region in the last six months (TRUE/FALSE).
host_age: Age of the host in years; can be fractional, e.g. 0.25 for 3 months.
host_subject_name: An identifier for the individual/person/patient the specimen was collected from.
lat_lon: Latitude and longitude of the collection site.
parasite_density: Parasite density in parasites per microlitre.
parasite_density_method: Method used to measure parasite density, e.g. qPCR, microscopy. Required if parasite_density is given.
specimen_accession: Accession of the specimen if deposited in a database.
storage_plate_name: Name of the plate the specimen is stored in.
storage_plate_row: Row of the plate the specimen is stored in, e.g. A.
storage_plate_col: Column of the plate the specimen is stored in, e.g. 1.
storage_plate_position: Well position on the storage plate, e.g. A1 (alternative to row and column).
specimen_collect_device: How the specimen was collected, e.g. whole blood, dried blood spot.
specimen_comments: Any additional comments about the specimen. Separate multiple comments with commas.
specimen_store_loc: The specimen storage site, address or facility name.
specimen_type: The type of specimen, e.g. negative_control, positive_control, field_sample.
treatment_status: Treatment outcome if the host was treated. Separate multiple values with commas.
project_description: A short description of the project.
BioProject_accession: An SRA BioProject accession, e.g. PRJNA33823.
project_collector_chief_scientist: Name of the primary person managing the specimens (separate multiple names with semicolons).
project_contributors: Collaborators who contributed to this project.
project_type: The type of project, e.g. TES, surveillance, transmission.
panel_name: A name for the panel; must match the panel name entered on the Panel Information page.
sequencing_info_name: A name for a specific sequencing run, e.g. batch1; must match a name in the Sequencing Info sheet.
experiment_accession: ERA/SRA experiment accession for the sample if submitted.
fastqs_loc: Location (URL or file path) of the FASTQs for this library.
library_prep_plate_name: Name of the plate the library was prepared on.
library_prep_plate_row: Row of the library prep plate, e.g. A.
library_prep_plate_col: Column of the library prep plate, e.g. 1.
library_prep_plate_position: Well position on the library prep plate, e.g. A1 (alternative to row and column).
run_accession: ERA/SRA run accession for the sample if submitted.
seq_platform: The sequencing technology, e.g. ILLUMINA, NANOPORE, PACBIO.
seq_instrument_model: The sequencing instrument model, e.g. NextSeq 2000, MinION, Revio.
library_layout: Configuration of reads, e.g. paired-end, single.
library_source: Source of the material, e.g. GENOMIC, TRANSCRIPTOMIC.
library_selection: How amplification was done, e.g. PCR, RANDOM.
library_kit: Name and version of the library prep kit, e.g. MiSeq Reagent Kit v3 (150-cycle), MS-102-3001.
library_screen: Enrichment, screening, or normalization methods, e.g. size selection 390bp.
nucl_acid_amp: Link to a reference or kit describing the nucleic acid amplification.
nucl_acid_ext: Link to a reference or kit describing the nucleic acid extraction.
pcr_cond: PCR method/conditions, e.g. number of cycles.
seq_center: Facility where sequencing was performed (lab, core facility, or company).
bioinformatics_run_name: A name for this bioinformatics run; must be unique to each run.
program: Name of the program used for this part of the pipeline.
program_version: Version of the program, e.g. v1.2.0.
additional_argument: Any arguments that differ from the program defaults.
program_description: A short description of what this method does.
program_url: A URL to the program's code base, e.g. a GitHub link.
total_raw_count: Total raw read count for this library sample.
stage: Name of the pipeline stage, e.g. demultiplexed, denoised.
read_count: Read count for this target at this stage.
